notes.title: Update: recommended save points
notes.notes:
I received some feedback that solving puzzles was sometimes made difficult by not knowing when to save -- especially in the latter half of the game, where getting into unwinnable states is possible. In response, I have injected a save prompt once a day as well as after achievements when new content has been unlocked.

I have also made a couple minor fixes in this update to dialogue.

notes.title: Manna for our Malices priced down to 99 cents
notes.notes:
In response to player feedback, I've lowered the price to $0.99.

For updates on future games in this series, please follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/37770146-Double-Mojo/]studio page[/url].

notes.title: Various bug fixes
notes.notes:
* Fixed audio levels on two tracks
* Prevented roof audio track from playing for the rest of the day if player goes from roof to classroom
* Replaced new altar images with original altar images
* Added cultural notes to 'About' tab in menu

Players will lose saves from this update.
